edges.reason: msg.sender is used as the source address of transfer.
transfer delegates execution to _transfer.
msg.sender flows into _transfer as the from argument.
from parameter feeds the zero-address and pair checks inside _transfer.
to parameter feeds the zero-address and pair checks inside _transfer.
amount parameter is validated and forwarded to _tokenTransfer.
_transfer require statement invokes the external Odin.amount view call before any state change.
_transfer performs an external swap before updating balances in _tokenTransfer.
swapTokensForEth performs the router swap external call.
_transfer sends ETH to the tax wallet before final balance updates.
sendETHToFee executes the ETH transfer to _taxWallet.
Router swap can re-enter transfer logic while inSwap is only cleared after the swap completes.
ETH transfer to a malicious _taxWallet can re-enter transfer/withdraw paths.
block.timestamp is supplied as the swap deadline.
block.timestamp is supplied as the addLiquidityETH deadline.
onlyOwner compares the caller against the stored _owner.
openTrading is protected by the onlyOwner modifier.
Caller must equal _owner to invoke openTrading.
renounceOwnership is gated by onlyOwner.
Caller must equal _owner to renounce ownership.
manualSwap requires msg.sender == _taxWallet.
_taxWallet is the address authorized to call manualSwap.
manualSend requires msg.sender == _taxWallet.
_taxWallet is the address authorized to call manualSend.
ETH is sent to the _taxWallet address.
openTrading calls addLiquidityETH with the contract balance.
openTrading assigns the newly created router into _router.
openTrading stores the created pair into _pair.
openTrading enables automatic swaps via swapEnabled.
openTrading flips tradingOpen to true.
transferFrom calls _transfer for the debited sender.
transferFrom calls _approve to decrement the allowance.
sender parameter is the allowance owner and transfer source.
recipient parameter is passed into _transfer.
_approve writes the allowance mapping.
_tokenTransfer eventually invokes _transferStandard.
_transferStandard calls _takeTeam with the team fee.
_transferStandard calls _reflectFee with the reflection fee.
SafeMath add updates the contract reflection balance and guards against overflow.
_transferStandard debits sender and credits recipient in _rOwned.
SafeMath sub decreases _rTotal and guards against underflow.
_reflectFee accumulates the token fee into _tFeeTotal.
tokenFromReflection obtains the current rate from _getRate.
balanceOf passes the account reflection balance to tokenFromReflection.
tAmount parameter drives the fee and reflection computations.
currentRate local is produced by _getRate.
rAmount local is subtracted from the sender balance.
tTeam local is multiplied by the rate inside _takeTeam.
tokenAmount parameter is the swap input amount.
path local array is passed to the router swap.
contractTokenBalance is passed into swapTokensForEth.
contractETHBalance is forwarded to sendETHToFee.
manualSwap feeds the contract balance into swapTokensForEth.
manualSend feeds the contract ETH balance into sendETHToFee.
inSwap guard is read to skip the auto-swap branch in _transfer.
lockTheSwap modifier sets and clears inSwap around the swap call.
swapEnabled gates the automatic swap/send branch in _transfer.
_tTotal is the token supply denominator used by _getRate.

normalization_plan.reason: The from parameter is only meaningful as an argument of _transfer.
The to parameter is only meaningful as an argument of _transfer.
The amount parameter exists solely to drive _transfer logic.
tokenAmount is consumed only by the swapTokensForEth call.
The amount parameter is consumed only by the sendETHToFee transfer.
sender exists only as an argument of transferFrom.
recipient exists only as an argument of transferFrom.
tAmount is only used by the _transferStandard reflection math.
account is only used as the input of tokenFromReflection.
contractTokenBalance flows directly into the swapTokensForEth call.
The path array is constructed only for the router swap.
currentRate is the return value of _getRate.
tTeam is the input amount processed by _takeTeam.
contractBalance in manualSwap is passed straight to swapTokensForEth.
contractETHBalance in manualSend is passed straight to sendETHToFee.
